messages:
Alex (partnerships): heads up — Azure marketplace scoping asked for SOC2 attestation + a pen‑test witness window for the ACME Gateway listing. They want evidence uploaded by EOD Friday. Who can own artifacts and the witness slot?
Priya (security): can take SOC2 attestation packaging. Need to confirm whether they want the full report or a redacted bundle. :lock:
Evan (cloud): I can handle presigned S3 links & upload pipeline. Do we have an existing evidence bucket for partner listings?
Tia (SI): SI team needs to be on the witness call for pen testing — we requested a remote witness last time. Preferred window: Mon/Tue next week morning PT.
Olivia (sales): Marketplace PM pushed for Friday because partner PR depends on the listing. Can we compress? Partner is flexible on witness date if artifacts upload is done by EOD.
Priya (security): redacted bundle is fine for public listing. For internal review we keep the full report in gated storage. I'll prepare a redaction checklist: sensitive keys, IP addresses, customer PII, and HSM logs.
Alex (partnerships): summary of asks: (1) SOC2 redacted bundle — owner Priya, (2) pen test witness scheduling — owner Tia, (3) evidence upload & presign links — owner Evan, (4) partner comms/PR timing — Olivia. Sound right?
Tia (SI): yep. I'll block tentative witness slots: Mon 9–11am PT, Tue 10–12pm PT. Which timezone does marketplace PM prefer?
Olivia (sales): I'll ask marketplace PM now. Expect reply in ~30m.
Evan (cloud): prepping upload process. Proposed workflow: create folder partners/acme/1749990000/ with 2 artifacts: soc2-redacted.zip and pen-test-report-redacted.pdf. Generate presigned links with 7‑day expiry. Example command I’ll run:```aws s3 presign s3://redwood-evidence/partners/acme/1749990000/soc2-redacted.zip --expires-in 604800```
Priya (security): for redaction checklist: we need a README that maps original file -> redacted/retained fields and an attest.txt signed by security lead. I will draft README and attest text.
marketplace-bot: Reminder: Marketplace evidence uploader expects metadata JSON with keys: partner_name, artifact_type, evidence_ts, contact_email. See https://marketplace.docs/upload for schema.
Alex (partnerships): good catch @marketplace-bot — Evan, can the uploader auto-attach metadata?
Evan (cloud): yes, I'll include metadata.json alongside artifacts. Template: {"partner_name":"ACME","artifact_type":"soc2,pen_test","evidence_ts":"1749990000","contact":"olivia@redwood.ai"} (I'll fill actual email).
Olivia (sales): marketplace PM replied — they can accept witness next Tue afternoon PT but need artifacts uploaded by Friday EOD. So we need to finish redaction and uploads within 48 hours.
Priya (security): copying checklist now. ETA for redacted SOC bundle: tomorrow 5pm PT. Will need a quick review signoff from legal for any aggressive redactions.
Tia (SI): I'll prioritize witness prep and share test scope we expect them to focus on (auth flows, KV cache leak surface, telemetry endpoints).
Alex (partnerships): action items: Priya -> SOC redaction & README (due tomorrow 5pm PT), Evan -> S3 folder + presigned links + metadata (due Fri EOD), Tia -> pen witness runbook + availability (confirm Tue), Olivia -> coordinate partner & PM comms. I'll send a short go/no-go check on Friday morning.
Olivia (sales): I'll also flag dependencies to partner: need CI logs and build artifacts from their ops by tomorrow noon.
Priya (security): noted. If partner can't supply full logs by noon we'll document the gap and request limited extension from marketplace PM.
Alex (partnerships): thanks everyone. Ping here when your item is done and paste presigned links into thread (no secrets in public channel — redacted artifacts only). :thumbsup:
Evan (cloud): will post presign links in thread when uploaded (links are time‑limited).
Tia (SI): will share witness runbook and pre-call checklist later today.
Priya (security): uploading initial redaction diff to gated repo and will attach final zip here once legal signs off.
Olivia (sales): looping in partner ops now. cc @marketplace-bot for final evidence ingestion steps. :wave:
